Reference 1 is existing native furniture atlas, reference 2 is actual 56x60 hero for pixel density and scale. Make one transparent atlas-like study with clean separated props: large slate/cream patterned living-room rug, sage/pink geometric dining rug, lavender bedroom rug, long narrow hall runner; white kitchen island with wood trim and two tucked stools; modular white/oak upper and lower cabinets with handles; a round wooden breakfast table with four cream chairs plus separate high chair; garage metal wall shelves with boxes/paper bins, tool pegboard, stacked totes, chest freezer, two adult bicycles; a little cluster of monstera/fern/snake plants, a woven basket, laundry pile with one lone sock, toy bin, shoes; cream wall module with sage baseboard and tiny abstract framed pictures. Top-down three-quarter matching existing kit exactly, crisp native 1px navy silhouette, 2-3 broad deliberate tones per material, no noisy speckle or dithering. NATIVE game-art appearance, not smooth vector mockups or realistic illustration. Materials explicitly white cabinetry FFF0CF/F2D7A1, wood D3B78D/A88B70/70402F, metal526078/303750, plants83A89A/3E7775, textiles muted slate/sage/lavender.
